continuation-H3-probe_start_failure_writ.mechanism: queued-abort terminal overwrite by startup exception handler
continuation-H3-probe_start_failure_writ.note: Deployment fails after the runner's SUBMITTED check, then queued abort writes ABORTED before the exception handler writes FAILED_TO_RUN (JR:661/715-720; JC:1063). A status-only variant of the F1 cancellation/lifecycle serialization family; this minimal path does not launch a process and does not independently establish the primary High impact. Overlapping terminal precedence remains a confirmation detail.
